criteria.behavior: The final subject and population are frozen and all upstream phase criteria have applicable evidence.
criteria.check: Run the required integrated lane and check-acceptance.py --green separately for P0–P12; inspect rc-manifest.json, coverage.md and evidence/dependency hashes.
criteria.expected: All required upstream criteria green; exact signed/runtime/model/harness/input population identified. No circular requirement that P13 already be green and no stale evidence substituted.

criteria.behavior: All task-category release bars and the aggressive interaction-goal scorecard are reported honestly on the final candidate.
criteria.check: Run the approved frozen qualification through the existing harness; inspect qualification.json and raw rows for every PROGRAM category and speed-goal ID.
criteria.expected: Original success/p50/Wilson requirements pass. New goal achievement or misses, meaningful p95 samples, cold/warm clocks, all failures and total costs are explicit; no partial/dispatch acknowledgment counted as effect.

criteria.behavior: Final safety/recovery cases have zero false Done, double dispatch, deny-list violation or automatic safety acknowledgment.
criteria.check: Inspect public-entry negative cases and independent oracles for ambiguity, absent/stale/wrong target, protected controls, cancel/barge-in and uncertain mutations.
criteria.expected: Correct refusal/recovery and independently verified results; no resampling, dropped gate, false continuity or unauthorized retry used to manufacture a pass.

criteria.behavior: The final signed application is qualified through normal physical Fn/pill/gaze and the declared real-app breadth.
criteria.check: Inspect current-artifact P3 physical population, signed replay, P11 camera/G6 evidence and native/browser/hero/replay raw results.
criteria.expected: Physical cases actually performed and independently observed; required breadth covered. One labeled Notes note only, existing notes untouched; Spotify playback only after local-device proof. Historical signed failure remains visible.

criteria.behavior: Matched head-to-head results meet the locked competitor requirements.
criteria.check: Inspect frozen shared tasks, competitor versions/input/start conditions, all paired rows and the head-to-head report.
criteria.expected: Faster than Codex CU on >=70% of shared tasks at equal-or-better strict success; browser subset within 1.2x Browser Use or faster. No unsupported global fastest claim or quick-refusal win.

criteria.behavior: The combined final product meets eye, resource, clean-install, first-use and demo bars.
criteria.check: Inspect signed P8/P11/P12 integrated evidence and final resource/recovery/first-use/demo rows on M1/8GB.
criteria.expected: >=15fps, >=80% first calibration, wake <=5s, dwell off default, RSS <=2.5GB, idle CPU <=10%, three moments <=3min and demo 10/10. No hidden disabled feature or developer dependency.

criteria.behavior: An independent final verdict and explicit ship decision bind the exact artifact, limitations and rollback.
criteria.check: Inspect judge-verdict.md, ship-decision.md, final acceptance validation, candidate/signature/rollback references and named-file handoff.
criteria.expected: Authorized fresh-context PASS; no unresolved finding or hidden speed-goal miss. Unmet new goals have an explicit user decision or remain release blockers; install/commit/merge/distribution is not presumed authorized.

criteria.behavior: Matched real-application dictation evidence establishes performance against Wispr Flow without conflating raw recognition, editing and insertion.
criteria.check: Inspect the COMPETITIVE frozen pilot/qualification manifests, paired raw outputs/audio hashes, literal/human adjudication, scorer version and signed insertion/readback records.
criteria.expected: Held-out >=120 distinct clips after the pilot, declared coverage/modes/context, WER/CER, critical-content errors, necessary edits, speech-end/Fn-release p50/p95 and tails. Quality/speed achievement or uncertainty is explicit; no official Voice Arena or physical-input claim from an adapted digital test.

criteria.behavior: Every shipped category has a correctness-and-speed scorecard and an evidence-bound leadership or gap statement.
criteria.check: Inspect COMPETITIVE category rows, paired comparisons and uncertainty, exact comparator/subject identities, resource/privacy/setup limits and the explicit ship decision.
criteria.expected: All rows reported as lead/parity/behind/inconclusive/not measured with reasons; no missing comparator counted as a win. Old minimum gates remain necessary, goal misses stay explicit, and global fastest/best claims are absent unless genuinely supported.
